_comment: Our protocol id -> the feed's own id for it. Every key below is a protocol version from registry/protocols.json, spelled exactly as the pipeline expects it. Put the feed's id in the value for each protocol the feed covers and delete the lines for the ones it does not. A value is a string, or a list when the feed files several things under one of our rows: ["aave/ethereum.md", "aave/prime.md"]. An empty value is refused once the feed is enabled (and by npm test), so a protocol cannot be forgotten by accident. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.
